newsitem.title: UK: MORI poll puts UK Labour lead down one point.
newsitem.headline: MORI poll puts UK Labour lead down one point.

text.p: An opinion poll to be published in the Times newspaper as Britons vote in a general election on Thursday puts the opposition Labour Party's lead down one point to 20 points ahead of the ruling Conservative Party.
The MORI poll said Labour support was unchanged at 48 percent, the Conservatives were up one point to 28 percent with the Liberal Democrats down one point to 16 percent.
